title: 税改非为增收：香港保障需求，韧性何在？
speaker: Stephen Engel

segments.en: And by all means, to me, this is not really for Chinese authorities to increase their revenue. Let's face it, you're taxing on the return, you're not taxing, it's not a state tax, right? So that amount is small, right, to my mind.
segments.zh: 在我看来，这并非内地当局为了增加收入。毕竟，这是对回报征税，不是国家税，所以金额很小。

segments.en: And actually, even if you say that, oh, we want to bring some business back from Hong Kong to mainland, for example, our number shows that all the Hong Kong policies and Hong Kong, it's only like low single digits equivalent to the mainland pie. So they're not trying to bring business back to mainland. It's not going to move the needle. For guys like, you know, AIA, 20% of the businesses in mainland China anyway, so they can effectively recapture some of that, right, along with prudential and some other people.
segments.zh: 即使说想把业务从香港带回内地，我们的数据显示，香港所有保障产品仅相当于内地市场的低个位数百分比。所以他们并非想把业务带回内地，这不会改变大局。对于友邦等公司，其20%的业务本就在内地，因此他们可以有效地重新获得部分业务，保诚等也是如此。

segments.en: Okay, so here's my question to you, Stephen. We did get a market reaction. It looks like we're going to get the clients again here today. Across these names, what do you think is the most vulnerable to this? Netnet, of course, you mentioned, of course, they do have business either side of the border. And my question to you, Steve, is, are we overthinking the insurance side of this and is this simply another exercise in terms of curbing illicit flows? Let me start with you.
segments.zh: 好的，Stephen，我的问题是，市场已有反应，今天可能再次下跌。在这些公司中，你认为谁最脆弱？当然，你提到他们两边都有业务。我的问题是，我们是否过度解读了保障方面，这仅仅是遏制非法资金流动的又一次行动？你先说。

segments.en: Surely from the main impact, I would say FWD, prudential, or the bigger impact, because they have less mainland exposure, the actual onshore mainland exposure, right? Now, if you look at just the Hong Kong business, by far, Hitchers PC is the most exposed for sure, right? But it gets watered down when it chain up to the group, right? Because the whole valuation of the life insurance companies is probably less than 10% of the whole group valuation.
segments.zh: 从主要影响来看，我认为富卫、保诚受影响更大，因为他们的内地敞口较小。如果只看香港业务，汇丰保险无疑敞口最大，但在集团层面被稀释了，因为保障业务估值可能不到集团总估值的10%。

segments.en: But how much of this is also just authorities sending a message? We saw it in June as well. This came out of the insurance and the banks here all tumbled because there was talk that, you know, authorities were asking banks to not open new bank accounts to mainland Chinese. And that sent a message to the market that this is possibly the beginning of an even larger and wider crackdown. And that is the question I think bankers are asking right now, wouldn't you agree?
segments.zh: 但其中有多少只是当局在传递信号？我们在六月也看到过。当时保障公司和银行都下跌，因为传闻当局要求银行不为内地居民开立新账户。这向市场传递了可能开始更大范围收紧的信号。我认为这正是银行家们现在在问的问题，你同意吗？
